test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘DELIGHT’ is written as ‘ZBACRYX’, and ‘STRANGE’ is written as ‘YATUXZY’. How will ‘STUMBLE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d91e269fc55c93408310ce28ecec3f7a7d47b358f186356476afe949d8d26783.png] 

**Logic:**

 
• **Reverse the Word.**
 
• ** Single digit place value - 6 and double digit place value + 6**

‘DELIGHT’ → ‘ZBACRYX’**​**

Reverse order of ‘DELIGHT’ = 'THGILED'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aca28e5064a4d54d758b415055da1c17e48403267fae827b01624a902a8eb1af.png] 

And

'STRANGE’ → ‘YATUXZY’

Reverse order of 'STRANGE’ = 'EGNARTS'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6dcb3e2a0115b6432a5bd289746c4ca5e0f863592f31d0c124318ca5795afdc5.png] 

Similarly,

**‘STUMBLE’ → ?**

**Reverse order of ‘STUMBLE’ = 'ELBMUTS'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60e1e438f4efa35121d8ae7c9b7d084278a34cb0fd4eda9878963c185be0349d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "YRVSAZY".**
